newsitem.title: USA: Cincinnati Milacron to buy Minnesota Twist.
newsitem.headline: Cincinnati Milacron to buy Minnesota Twist.

text.p: Cincinnati Milacron Inc said Tuesday it will buy privately-held Minnesota Twist Drill Inc for an undisclosed amount of cash.
The company said Minnesota, a maker of high-speed twist drills, has 100 employees and annual sales of more than $10 million. It added it expected to close the deal in September.
Minnesota, which has a plant in Chisholm, Minn., will become a subsidiary of Talbot Holdings, which is a part of Cincinnati subsidiary Valenite, a company statment said.
Cincinnati's stock traded at 27-1/2 Tuesday afternoon, down 1/4 but close to its 52-week high of 27-13/16.
